Container.Name: ignidash
Container.Overview: Self-hosted personal financial planning: Monte Carlo retirement projections, historical backtesting and US tax estimation. One container runs both the Convex backend and the Next.js app; open the WebUI and create the first account.
Container.Description:
Ignidash is a single-container, offline-friendly financial planner. The container supervises two processes: the Convex backend (database, functions, HTTP actions on 3210/3211) and the Next.js app (3000).
The browser talks to the Convex API directly, so ports 3210 and 3211 must be reachable from client machines as well as 3030.
Appdata: /mnt/user/appdata/ignidash holds the SQLite database, uploaded file storage and the Convex instance credentials. Back that path up (the Appdata Backup plugin covers it); it is the only stateful volume.
First run: the image does not carry your functions, and auth settings are read from Convex, not from this container. Once it is healthy, deploy the functions and set SELF_HOSTED, SITE_URL, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET and ALLOW_SIGNUP in Convex from a checkout (SELF_HOSTING.md, First run on Unraid). ALLOW_SIGNUP is needed both here (the signup page reads it) and in Convex (the auth server reads it). Create your account, then clear it in both places. Upgrade by changing the Repository tag or digest; take a backup first (scripts/backup.sh) because the backend applies in-place migrations on start.
Full documentation: https://github.com/calmcoconut/ignidash/blob/main/SELF_HOSTING.md

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Ignidash app (HTTP).

Config.Name: Convex API Port
Config.Description: Convex API and WebSocket. Must be reachable from the browser; put it behind TLS if you expose it beyond the LAN.

Config.Name: Convex Actions Port
Config.Description: Convex HTTP actions (auth callbacks).

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: SQLite database, file storage and the Convex instance credentials. Edit this to move the appdata elsewhere; keep it backed up.

Config.Name: Site URL
Config.Description: Public URL of the app, as the browser sees it. Use the LAN IP or hostname, not localhost, when reaching it from another machine.

Config.Name: Convex public URL
Config.Description: Convex API URL the browser uses.

Config.Name: Convex site URL
Config.Description: Convex HTTP actions URL the browser uses (auth callbacks).

Config.Name: Auth secret
Config.Description: Secret for sessions and JWKs. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32 . Generate once and keep it: changing it invalidates every session and encrypted JWK, and the only recovery is restoring a backup.

Config.Name: Internal Convex URL
Config.Description: Server-side Convex URL. Loopback: server traffic never leaves the container.

Config.Name: Internal Convex site URL
Config.Description: Server-side Convex HTTP actions URL (loopback).

Config.Name: Advertised Convex origin
Config.Description: Origin the backend advertises to clients. Must match NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL.

Config.Name: Advertised Convex site origin
Config.Description: Origin the backend advertises for HTTP actions. Must match NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_SITE_URL.

Config.Name: Disable telemetry
Config.Description: Stops the backend's hourly beacon. Leave true for a private instance.

Config.Name: Backend log level
Config.Description: Convex backend log level.

Config.Name: Allow signup
Config.Description: Account creation is LOCKED unless this is exactly true. Bootstrap: set true, create your account, then clear it and restart. Password reset does not need it (/forgot-password writes the link to the container log).

Config.Name: Google client ID
Config.Description: Optional Google sign-in. The button also requires NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_OAUTH_ENABLED=true at image build time, so the published image does not show it.

Config.Name: Google client secret
Config.Description: Optional Google sign-in secret.

Config.Name: OpenAI API key
Config.Description: Optional: enables AI chat and insights. Leave empty to hide both.

Config.Name: OpenAI base URL
Config.Description: Optional: any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM, LM Studio) to keep AI traffic on the LAN.

Config.Name: Azure OpenAI endpoint
Config.Description: Optional: Azure OpenAI endpoint, used only when OPENAI_BASE_URL is empty.

Config.Name: Chat model
Config.Description: Optional: model or deployment name for chat.

Config.Name: Insights model
Config.Description: Optional: model or deployment name for insights.
